spec.name: Zaouiya Ennaciria
spec.description: The Zaouiya Ennaciria in Larache is a branch of the influential Naciria Sufi brotherhood, originally founded in Tamegroute. Located in the Bab al-Bahr neighborhood of the old medina, it historically served as a center for spiritual guidance, Quranic education, and social welfare. During the Spanish protectorate, it played a vital role in preserving Moroccan cultural and religious identity by continuing the teaching of Arabic and Islamic sciences.

timeline.title: Establishment
timeline.description: Establishment of the Naciria presence in Larache as part of the brotherhood's nationwide expansion.

timeline.title: Spanish Protectorate Era
timeline.description: Begins serving as a cultural resistance center during the Spanish Protectorate era.
